## [1.35.0](https://github.com/BlazeFTL/FTL-Patches/compare/v1.34.0...v1.35.0) (2026-08-18)

### ✨ New Features

* Improved analytics and crash-reporting removal with broader ad/analytics SDK detection, safer string matching, Firebase auto-initialization cleanup, and improved SDK signature-check handling.
* Expanded APK junk cleanup to remove additional feature-delivery, mobile-ads, version, and Kotlin tooling metadata.
* Added Xender support for version 18.8.0.prime with Speed Up Splash Screen patch.
